text: Bug fix: Import errors now show each distinct message once instead of repeating it.
Bug fix: Add and remove buttons beside hero portraits on the Position Board are smaller.
Feature: The Position Board map picker lists every available map and marks maps that still need an image as placeholders.
Feature: A draft or comp can now use several maps or a whole game mode.

Feature: Cradle: Krakoa (Domination), Hall of Djalia and Symbiotic Surface (Convergence), and Arakko, Midtown, Thebes, Yggdrasill Path and Spider-Islands (Convoy) are now available as Position Board maps.
